name: Agency starter
description: A starting point for client agents: questions, bookings, messages, and urgent calls put through to the owner.

nodes.name: Find out why they're calling
nodes.prompt: Find out what the caller needs. If they already said it in their first words, move on right away instead of asking again.

when.intent: wants to book an appointment, a visit or a consultation
has a question about services, prices, hours or the service area
is a telemarketer, robocall or sales pitch

nodes.name: Answer questions
nodes.prompt: Answer from the knowledge base. Never guess a price, a policy or availability that isn't there; offer to take a message instead.

nodes.name: Booking details
nodes.prompt: Get what the business needs before booking. Ask one thing at a time.

nodes.name: Book the appointment
nodes.prompt: Offer two open times from availability, such as the soonest, or ones near a day the caller already mentioned. If neither works, ask what day or time of day suits them and offer the closest open times. As soon as the caller picks one, book it; don't ask them to confirm first.

nodes.name: Confirm the booking
nodes.prompt: The appointment is booked. Confirm the day and time in one short sentence and ask if there's anything else.

nodes.name: Put them through to the owner
nodes.message: I'm getting someone for you now. Please stay on the line.

nodes.name: Urgent message
nodes.prompt: Nobody could take the call, and you've marked it urgent. Take a message with what's happening. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first. Say someone will call back as soon as possible, and never promise a time.

nodes.name: Take a message
nodes.prompt: Take a message for the team. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first. Never invent prices.

nodes.name: Wrap up the message
nodes.prompt: The message is saved. Tell the caller the team will call back during business hours and ask if there's anything else.

nodes.name: Decline politely
nodes.message: Politely say the business isn't interested, without sharing any business details.

when.intent: describes something urgent that can't wait for a callback, or is upset about a job in progress

fields.label: Service needed
fields.description: What they want done, in their words.

fields.label: Service address
fields.description: Street address, if the work happens on site.

fields.label: How they heard about us
fields.description: Marketing source, if mentioned. Useful for reporting to the client.
